body.faq_description: Common questions about IGENTX products, who they are for, and how we support implementation.

faqs.question: What products does IGENTX offer?
faqs.answer: IGENTX currently offers two live products: AI Customer Service Agent, a 24/7 website chat assistant for businesses, and DaycareMate, a childcare centre management platform for early childhood education providers. More AI-powered products are in development.

faqs.question: Who are IGENTX products for?
faqs.answer: The AI Customer Service Agent suits any business that wants more leads, faster support and better website engagement. DaycareMate serves preschools, nurseries, childcare centres and early learning providers that need admissions, daily care, family communication and billing in one system.

faqs.question: How does the AI Customer Service Agent work?
faqs.answer: The agent is trained on your website content, documents and FAQs using retrieval-augmented generation. It answers visitor questions instantly, captures contact details naturally in chat, and saves enquiries to your admin dashboard. Integration takes one line of code on any website.

faqs.question: Is the AI Customer Service Agent multilingual?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent supports multilingual conversations so visitors can get accurate responses in their preferred language. This is valuable for global businesses and teams serving diverse local and international audiences.

faqs.question: What is DaycareMate?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate is a complete childcare management platform built by IGENTX. It covers admissions with magic-link onboarding, attendance, activity feed, messaging, invoice-first billing and dedicated Admin, Teacher and Family portals.

faqs.question: Is DaycareMate only for UAE centres?
faqs.answer: No. DaycareMate is built for early childhood education providers worldwide. Currency, timezone and tax settings are configurable per deployment. The UAE is our primary market, not the geographic limit of the product.

faqs.question: Can I try a product before committing?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can explore the AI Customer Service Agent demo on its product page, visit daycaremate.com for DaycareMate, or book a free consultation with IGENTX to see which product fits your goals and walk through setup options.

faqs.question: Does IGENTX provide setup and ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Yes. IGENTX builds, deploys and supports its products. Our team helps with implementation, configuration and ongoing optimisation so you get measurable results from day one.
